export declare const CONTENT_TAGS: readonly ["p", "br", "h1", "h2", "h3", "h4", "h5", "h6", "blockquote", "ul", "ol", "li", "strong", "em", "del", "code", "pre", "hr", "a", "table", "thead", "tbody", "tr", "th", "td", "details", "summary", "sup", "sub", "kbd"];

export declare const GAP = 8;
// exported from this entry as "FLOATING_GAP"

export declare const MARGIN = 8;
// exported from this entry as "FLOATING_MARGIN"

export interface FloatingAnchor {
    left: number;
    top: number;
    bottom: number;
    right: number;
}

export type FloatingMode = "below" | "above" | "beside";

export interface FloatingSize {
    width: number;
    height: number;
}

export declare const NON_TEXT_TAGS: readonly ["script", "style", "textarea", "option", "xmp", "noscript", "template", "iframe", "object", "embed", "svg", "math", "form"];

export type SubtaskActionOutcome = {
    readonly state: "applied";
} | {
    readonly state: "not-applied";
    readonly reason: string;
} | {
    readonly state: "unknown";
    readonly check: () => Promise<SubtaskActionOutcome>;
};

export type SubtaskComposerOptions = Omit<Extract<ComposerOptions, {
    kind: "ai";
}>, "draft" | "placement" | "stop" | "pause"> & {
    readonly draft: {
        readonly adapter: ComposerDraftAdapter;
    };
};

export interface SubtaskConversationHandle {
    open(target: string): Promise<void>;
    refresh(): Promise<void>;
    close(): void;
    destroy(): void;
}

export interface SubtaskConversationOptions {
    readonly labels: MwSubtaskConversationLabels;
    readonly source: SubtaskConversationSource;
    onBack(parent: MwSubtaskLink | undefined): void;
    onClose(): void;
}

export type SubtaskConversationRead = {
    readonly state: "available";
    readonly view: MwSubtaskConversationView;
} | {
    readonly state: "denied";
    readonly reason: string;
};

export interface SubtaskConversationSource {
    read(target: string, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<SubtaskConversationRead>;
    subscribe?(target: string, invalidate: () => void, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<() => void>;
    composer(view: MwSubtaskConversationView): SubtaskComposerOptions;
    check(target: string, requestId: string, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<SubtaskActionOutcome>;
    act(view: MwSubtaskConversationView, action: MwSubtaskAction, requestId: string, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<SubtaskActionOutcome>;
}

export declare function clampTo(value: number, limit: number, length: number): number;

export declare const codeOf: (error: unknown) => string | undefined;

export declare function contentHtml(markup: string, ownerDocument?: Document): string;

export declare function createSubtaskConversation(root: HTMLElement, options: SubtaskConversationOptions): SubtaskConversationHandle;

export declare function followScroll(panel: Element, run: () => void): () => void;

export declare const isAbort: (error: unknown) => boolean;

export declare const jsonComparisonText: (value: unknown) => string | undefined;

export declare const messageOf: (error: unknown) => string;

export declare function pick(preferred: number, alternate: number, preferredFits: boolean, alternateFits: boolean, preferredRoom: number, alternateRoom: number): number;
// exported from this entry as "pickSide"

export declare function pinAt(el: HTMLElement, left: number, top: number): void;

export declare function placeFloating(anchor: FloatingAnchor, size: FloatingSize, viewport: {
    width: number;
    height: number;
}, mode: FloatingMode): {
    left: number;
    top: number;
};

export declare function placeOverlay(el: HTMLElement, anchor: FloatingAnchor, mode: FloatingMode, stage?: string): void;

export declare function placeStacked(anchor: FloatingAnchor, size: FloatingSize, viewport: {
    width: number;
    height: number;
}, mode: "above" | "below"): {
    left: number;
    top: number;
};

export declare function pluginRequest(host: PluginRequestHost, { fallback, codes, readRefusal, scope, project }: PluginRequestOptions): <T>(method: "GET" | "POST", path: string, body?: Record<string, unknown>, signal?: AbortSignal) => Promise<T>;

export declare function requiredQuery(missing: (selector: string) => string): <T extends Element = HTMLElement>(root: ParentNode, selector: string) => T;

export declare function scrollShouldFollow(target: EventTarget | null, panel: Element | null): boolean;

export declare function setContentHtml(target: Element, markup: string): void;

export declare const statusOf: (error: unknown) => number | undefined;

export declare function textCell(className: string, text: string): HTMLSpanElement;

// Declarations the exports above refer to, which no entry exports itself:

type PluginRequestHost = Pick<UiPluginClientHost, "pluginRoute"> & Partial<Pick<UiPluginClientHost, "route" | "readRefusal">>;

interface PluginRequestOptions {
    fallback(): string;
    readonly codes?: Readonly<Record<string, () => string>>;
    readonly readRefusal?: boolean;
    readonly scope?: UiRequestScope;
    readonly project?: {
        id(): string;
        missing(): string;
        readonly includeInRequest?: boolean;
    };
}
